messages:
lena-partnerops: Heads-up - NovaEdge wants to onboard to marketplace. Their edge agent emits per-minute pulses but with fractional seconds and occasional duplicates. Seller portal expects hourly entitlements. Need design for ingest, rounding/proration, and reconciliation. cc @tom-eng @paul-billing

tom-eng: Can you share a sample of what they send? fractional seconds example?

lena-partnerops: example from their CSV webhook: ```timestamp,device,sku,seconds_used
2026-03-20T09:12:15.432Z,ne-9001,edge-standard,30.5
2026-03-20T09:12:45.120Z,ne-9001,edge-standard,29.7``` They batch every minute and send a signed POST to our ingest endpoint.

paul-billing: For billing we need consistent units. Proposal: convert seconds to minutes (ceil to nearest second, then sum seconds per UTC hour and divide by 60, rounding to two decimal places for entitlement display but billing uses whole-minute buckets by standard market policy). Also require idempotency key: (partner_id,batch_id).

tom-eng: Implementation details: ingest adapter will accept per-event seconds_used, normalize to integer seconds, dedupe by (device, timestamp_second, sku), then aggregate to UTC hour windows. Keep raw events in WORM cold storage for 120 days for audit. Late-arrival window?

lena-partnerops: NovaEdge asked for 72h backfill due to intermittent connectivity; marketplace policy is 48h. Recommend we allow 48h, accept up to 72h as "manual review" with flagging.

nora-ps: Product wants seller-portal to show both the rounded-hour entitlement and the raw-minute breakdown in a debug-mode. Also need a clear post-cut label: "Adjusted after billing cut" if entitlement changed after reconciliation.

mei-qa: QA cases: (1) duplicate batch replay, (2) fractional second rounding consistency, (3) late-arrival at 30h and 70h, (4) device time skew where timestamps are within same hour but device clock off by +/-2min. I'll author tests for all.

paul-billing: Reconciliation: nightly job that joins partner-reported aggregates vs our rolled-up hours. Report schema for diffs: {run_id, partner_id, sku, hour_start, reported_minutes, our_minutes, delta_minutes, reason_code}. Tolerance: absolute delta <=1 minute or relative <=0.25% for large volumes, else create ticket to partner ops.

tom-eng: Emit reconciliation events to metering topic with run_id tag. Also include provenance fields: ingest_batch_id, raw_s3_path. Use X-Redwood-Signature on callbacks.

deploy-bot: delivery: reconciliation-webhook to novaedge-api returned 503 for run run-20260320-09 at 2026-03-21T02:14:08Z - scheduled retries.

lena-partnerops: We'll share the 48h acceptance window and the manual-review process for >48h. Ask NovaEdge to include batch_id in webhook and keep monotonically increasing sequence numbers.

nora-ps: UX note: seller portal delta emails should include hour_start, delta_minutes, short reason (late_backfill | duplicate_dedup | rounding_adjustment). Also allow seller to opt-in to daily diff webhooks.

mei-qa: Will add test vectors: overlapping seconds that cross hour boundary (e.g., 09:59:59.9 -> 10:00:00.1), ensure boundary attribution follows UTC alignment and seconds go to correct hour.

paul-billing: Invoicing behavior: only include entitlements marked final at cut. Post-cut deltas should be credited on next invoice cycle and flagged in ledger with adjustment reason. Ensure no double billing if partner replays identical batch with same batch_id.

tom-eng: Action items: spike adapter + dedupe logic (owner: tom-eng), add cold storage retention policy (owner: infra), add reconciliation webhook (owner: nora-ps), QA vectors (owner: mei-qa), billing playbook for credit adjustments (owner: paul-billing).

lena-partnerops: I'll schedule partner sandbox run for next Wednesday and request sample batch_ids.

nora-ps: I'll draft seller-portal debug UI and email spec.

mei-qa: QA will run sandbox tests and post results in this thread.

paul-billing: I'll also add regression tests to catch double-counting on backfills.

lena-partnerops: Thanks team :rocket: Please update the onboarding doc with the batch_id requirement and the 48h policy.
